children: Myseum.AI entered into a Second Amendment to its Sales Agreement to assign Benchmark’s obligations to StoneX Financial, which will now serve as the Sales Agent for the company’s at-the-market equity offering program. The amendment, signed September 21, 2026, updates all references to Benchmark to refer to StoneX Financial, an SEC-registered broker-dealer. The company also filed an updated prospectus supplement to reflect the change, aiming to maintain continuity in its equity distribution efforts.
: Second Amendment to Sales Agreement (at-the-market equity offering program)
